content.overview: This clinical guideline discusses various research studies focusing on depression, psychological health, and their associations with cardiovascular diseases such as coronary artery disease and myocardial infarction. It references several studies that examine the impacts of depression treatment, psychological well-being, and cognitive behavioral therapy on patients with cardiovascular conditions. The guideline highlights the standard treatment protocols to reduce cardiovascular events and summarizes systematic reviews and meta-analyses on these interrelationships.
